documented_behavior: Android's java.text.SimpleDateFormat documentation states that date formats are not synchronized, recommends separate formatter instances for each thread, and states that concurrent access must be synchronized externally.
Its inherited DateFormat API supplies format operations; SimpleDateFormat.format(Date, StringBuffer, FieldPosition) formats a Date into date/time text.
preconditions: The receiver is a java.text.SimpleDateFormat instance.
More than one thread can access the same formatter instance concurrently.
The accesses are not externally serialized using one mechanism that covers the formatter operations.
unknowns: The documentation establishes a synchronization requirement; it does not guarantee a particular observable failure for every overlap.
The supplied finding does not include the field declaration, import statement, formatter pattern, Android API level, or source revision.
It is not established whether the formatter is only used for format operations or is also reconfigured or used for parsing elsewhere.

name: ThreadUnsafeDateFormatSpec
semantic_scope: The detector report statically associates com.zoffcc.applications.trifa.HelperGeneric.long_date_time_format with a call to MainActivity.df_date_time_long.format(...) and describes other potential callers from UI view holders and receive_incoming_message on a Tox native-callback thread. The governed API concern is concurrent access to one shared java.text.SimpleDateFormat instance; parsing, unrelated formatter instances, and formatter types not resolved to java.text.SimpleDateFormat are outside this bounded finding.
known_false_positive_shapes: All formatter calls are confined to one serialized UI thread despite multiple statically visible call paths.
The native callback dispatches work onto the same serialized executor before formatting.
Every access is protected by the same external lock or monitor, but the lock is acquired in callers or helper methods outside the detector's local view.
The field is static but is initialized, replaced, or accessed only during non-overlapping lifecycle phases.
The reported helper or callback path is unreachable in the analyzed build variant.
The apparent formatter reference is an alias to a per-thread or per-call formatter rather than the shared field.
protocol: shared static SimpleDateFormat F → context A invokes F.format(...) ∥ context B invokes F.format(...) → no common external serialization of F

detector_examples.message: Static candidate (not executed): long_date_time_format formats with MainActivity.df_date_time_long, a single static SimpleDateFormat, which is called both from message list view holders on the UI thread and from receive_incoming_message on the Tox native callback thread; SimpleDateFormat is not thread-safe, so concurrent calls can produce corrupted timestamps or throw (CWE-362).
